data.name: Izharoon
data.gender_notes: Izharoon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings light, illumination. The name Izharoon carries the meaning “Radiant, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Izharoon usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of divine light in the child's life
data.etymology: Izharoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izharoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إظهرون

in_urdu.name: اظہرون
in_urdu.long_meaning: اظہرون ایک عربی نام ہے جو فعل اظہر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حق یا حقیقت کو ظاہر کرنا، اسلامی تاریخ میں یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو حق اور انصاف کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں، اور اس سے روحانی اور ثقافتی معنوں میں حق اور صداقت کے اظہار کا مفہوم اخذ ہوتا ہے

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Izharoon" represents the idea of being a source of light and guidance for others. In Islamic tradition, light is commonly used as a metaphor for knowledge and truth. By having the name "Izharoon," one is recognized as an individual who is responsible for spreading knowledge and truth to those around them. This can take various forms, such as teaching, sharing wisdom, or leading by example. In this sense, the name "Izharoon" carries a significant cultural impact by encouraging individuals to be active contributors to their communities and to strive for knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Izharoon" signifies the importance of being a carrier of light in the world. In Islamic belief, every human being has a divine purpose and is called upon to be a servant of God. By embodying the qualities of light and illumination, one is fulfilling their spiritual duty to bring knowledge, guidance, and truth to others. This name is a constant reminder that every individual has the power to make a positive impact on the world and to contribute to the greater good. Moreover, those with the name "Izharoon" are encouraged to seek knowledge and wisdom in their own lives, as they are the ones who will be expected to share this with others. Overall, the name "Izharoon" holds deep spiritual significance as it encourages individuals to be beacons of light and knowledge in a world that needs guidance and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant, Bright" symbolizes One who brings light, illumination. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Izharoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant, bright.
